title: Scenic Half Marathon Chiang Mai (CMSH) 2026 Review: A Royal Botanical Garden Run
seo_title: Scenic Half Marathon Chiang Mai 2026 Review | CMSH
meta_description: Scenic Half Marathon Chiang Mai 2026 review: November 1 at Royal Park Rajapruek -- a 200-acre botanical garden built to honor King Bhumibol.
dek: Set for 1 November 2026 at Royal Park Rajapruek, this Chiang Mai leg of the Scenic Marathon series -- the same organiser behind the Krabi half marathon covered elsewhere in this research -- runs through a 200-acre royal botanical garden.
verdict: The Scenic Half Marathon Chiang Mai puts runners inside Royal Park Rajapruek, a 200-acre botanical garden established in 2006 to honour King Bhumibol Adulyadej's 60th throne anniversary and 80th birthday. That's a genuinely different setting from the beach and city venues dominating most of this research batch -- 23 internationally donated themed gardens plus nine Thai and six corporate gardens, all within a park named for Thailand's national flower. Four distances (21.1K down to 3K) give it broad accessibility, and it's run by the same Scenic Marathon organisation behind the Krabi race covered elsewhere in this research, suggesting a consistent operational approach.

sections.heading: Racing Inside a Royal Botanical Garden
paragraphs: The race offers four distances -- 21.1K, 10K, 5K and 3K -- at Royal Park Rajapruek in Chiang Mai. [1] The park is a 200-acre botanical garden established in 2006 to commemorate King Bhumibol Adulyadej's 60th anniversary on the throne and his 80th birthday, showcasing Thailand's native flora and fauna alongside notable architectural structures. Its name, Rajapruek, refers to the golden shower tree, Thailand's national flower, symbolising the unity and continuity of the Thai nation.

sections.heading: 23 International Gardens
paragraphs: The park includes 23 themed gardens donated by international governments, plus nine Thai gardens and six 'corporate' gardens -- originally built to showcase Thai horticulture as the International Horticultural Exposition, Royal Flora Rajapruek 2006, before being renamed and established as a permanent attraction. [2] Running a course through this kind of formal, internationally curated garden landscape is genuinely rare among the races in this research batch.

sections.heading: Same Organiser as the Krabi Race
paragraphs: This event is run by RACEUP WORK CO., LTD. through the Scenic Marathon organisation -- the same operator behind the Scenic Half Marathon Krabi covered elsewhere in this research batch. [1] That shared organisational structure across a beach venue (Krabi) and a botanical garden venue (Chiang Mai) suggests a versatile, multi-region operation with tested logistics.

sections.heading: Four Distances for a Broad Field
paragraphs: Registration is currently open across all four distances -- 21.1K, 10K, 5K and 3K -- offering genuine accessibility from serious half-marathon runners down to casual and family participants.

sections.heading: Should You Run It?
paragraphs: If running through a genuinely beautiful, internationally curated royal botanical garden appeals, the Scenic Half Marathon Chiang Mai on 1 November 2026 is one of the more visually distinctive races in this research batch. Registration is open now, with the same organisational team as the well-established Krabi race backing it.
